transfer_failure.criterion: a score above 246.3577 -- a move under +0.0028 s, the lowest transfer ever observed on this board (0.36x, v16) applied to the lower end of this candidate's own face interval (+0.00784 s) -- and a score at or above v18's 246.3605 is not a weak transfer but no transfer at all

resolution.reading: NO -- the move is not inside the board's last digit.  The board reports four decimals, so one step is 0.0001 s; the move at face is 194 steps and even the smallest move in the whole band is 28 steps.  The candidate is resolvable.  What IS fine here is the FAILURE TEST: only 28 steps separate the failure line from 'no transfer at all', so that half of the reading rests on the third and fourth decimals and any board-side variation above 0.003 s would blur it -- none has been observed across BOARD READINGS 12-17, every one of which reconciled exactly at four decimals

rank.note: every band above leaves rank 1 by more than 14 s; the second team is at 260.931 and no outcome here moves us by more than 0.07 s

what_this_does_not_claim: it does not predict the direction of the surprise: the six transfers do not form a trend, and the desk's own currency note says the spread is not yet explained, so a wide band is the honest one.  Nor is it a claim that the rider is worth uploading a slot for -- that is the desk's call and this is only the reading rule for it.
